versos.texto_bv: Ai daquele que dá de beber ao seu próximo, misturando na bebida a sua fúria, e o embriaga, para contemplar a nudez dele!
versos.traducao_literal: Ai o que dá de beber ao seu próximo, ajuntando a tua ira, e também embriagando, para olhar sobre a nudez deles.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0031): O hebraico 'מעוריהם' (ma'oreihem) tem sufixo 3mp, significando 'a nudez DELES' (plural). A KJV confirma: 'that thou mayest look on their nakedness' (plural). A BV tem 'a nudez dele' (singular). A discrepância de número (plural vs. singular) é conteúdo — a fidelidade de conteúdo é absoluta e nunca cede. — evidência: Hebraico: למען הביט על מעוריהם (sufixo 3mp). KJV: 'that thou mayest look on their nakedness' (plural). BV: 'para contemplar a nudez dele' (singular).

kjv.texto: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!

vizinhos.14: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.
vizinhos.16: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the Lord’s right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.

web.texto: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!

vizinhos.14: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of Yahweh’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.
vizinhos.16: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink, and be exposed! The cup of Yahweh’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.
